long_description:
Join guest facilitator Kira Wong for a monthly somatic breathwork experience designed to support nervous system regulation, emotional release, greater self-awareness, and a deeper connection with yourself.

Breathwork may help reduce stress and anxiety, release stored tension and emotions, improve emotional clarity, increase presence, and help you reconnect with yourself.

Each month may feature a different intention, offering a unique opportunity to breathe, feel, release, and reconnect. No previous breathwork experience is necessary.

🗓 Second Saturday of every month

⏰ 10:30–11:30 AM

✨ Beginning in August

📍 Align Holistic
